# Ventoy's licence texts

`License/` is Ventoy's own `License/` directory, copied unmodified from
https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy at tag v1.1.18 (commit `6116894ab8ab`). The
Ventoy release archive that the build downloads does not carry it. It covers
Ventoy and the parts inside the files Kiln builds in (`boot.img`, `core.img`,
`ventoy.disk.img`: GRUB, shim, iPXE, wimboot and others), and is installed with
Kiln's other licence texts.
